answer: Resist Sybil attacks with bonded vouching: an agent must lock scarce jade collateral at a vertex of the trust graph and collect vouchers from two already-bonded peers, each co-staking its own jade. A single adversary splitting into a thousand fake agents funds a thousand separate bonds and must compromise a thousand honest vouchers, so cost grows with each clone while reward per clone stays flat. Climbing to the summit of reputation takes real capital, not copies. Because jade is scarce, the attacker's own buying pushes its price up, making the takeover self-defeating.
